title: Produce a researched VCF 9.1 migration architecture
prompt:
Produce the migration architecture for the existing Copper Ridge VMware Cloud Foundation estate. Return the architecture as the JSON emitted by a single-file Java client, not as a prose recommendation.

Before implementing, research Broadcom's current Product Interoperability Matrix, upgrade-path information, and VCF 9.1 upgrade guidance. Confirm the supported combinations and transition paths relevant to every product in `estate-inventory.json`, including the legacy monitoring product whose direct hop crosses its support boundary. Do not infer compatibility from version numbers alone. Record the pages you consulted in a top-level `researchConsulted` array in the emitted JSON, with a title, URL, access date, and a short statement of the compatibility or sequencing fact used.

Implement `MigrationPlanClient.java` only. Keep it dependency-free and compatible with `TestMain.java`. `MigrationPlanClient.buildPlan(String inventoryJson, String compatibilitySnapshotJson)` must return one JSON document. Its migration-plan fields must conform to `migration-plan-schema.json`. Its `targetSddcSpec` must validate against the VCF 9.1 installer schema and carry forward the estate's supplied DNS, management-network, and existing-vCenter design values.

Build an ordered plan that names every inventory component, its exact current product and version, exact next product and version, action, and all compatibility gates for that transition. Use only supported transition edges. Do not collapse or skip an intermediate release, replace an in-place transition with a fresh deployment, or perform a step before its gates are true. Do not modify the fixtures, schemas, `TestMain.java`, or test script. Run `bash run_tests.sh`.
